scripts.dev: npm run setup:d1 && npm run dev:worker & npm run trigger:cron & npm run dev:next & wait
scripts.start: echo 'Not applicable for Cloudflare Pages. Use preview to run locally, or deploy to CF Pages.'
scripts.clean: export $(cat .env | xargs) && lsof -ti :$PORT -ti :$PAGES_PORT | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dev:worker: export $(cat .env | xargs) && cd worker && npx wrangler dev --port $PORT --test-scheduled --persist-to ../.wrangler/state --env-file ../.env < /dev/null
scripts.deploy:secrets: cd worker && while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do [ -n "$key" ] && printf '%s' "$value" | wrangler secret put "$key"; done < ../.env
